tools.name: timing_calibration_analyze
tools.title: Capture-latency calibration record (experimental)
tools.description: From an operator calibration clip (click only, offbeat palm-muted and open pick attacks, optional played-on-click check) and mic distances, estimate the offset between the in-room acoustic click and amplified pick attacks as a GUM expanded-uncertainty correction (acoustic path, amp chain, per-class detector bias, residual). Writes one fresh calibration-record.json; abstains when the expanded uncertainty exceeds the 5 ms decision margin. Analysis only; never a performance grade.
tools.intent: Give a musician a calibrated, uncertainty-bounded capture offset so later phrase timing can say ahead/behind the click only when the evidence supports it.

input.description: Calibration clip (WAV/MOV/M4A/MP4, at most 600 s) or a run directory containing denoised.wav and manifest.json. Read only; its sha256 is recorded and re-checked.

segments.description: Operator-reviewed SEG.json: {schema_version: 1, segments: [{kind, start_seconds, end_seconds, review_text}]} with kinds click_only, offbeat_palm_muted, offbeat_open, on_click_palm_muted; bounded regular .json, at most 64 MiB; traversal, URL and symlinked-file inputs reject. Read only.

amp_chain.description: analog (0 +/- 0.1 ms), declared:MS (+/- 0.5 ms, 0-50 ms) or unknown (always abstains).

setup_id.description: Operator label binding the record to one phone/app/room/amp/metronome placement.

room_temp_c.description: Optional room temperature (+/-2 C); omitted means 15-30 C.

output_root.description: Directory beneath repository artifacts/ (never artifacts/runs); each call writes records/<UTC>-<hex12>/calibration-record.json.

timeout_seconds.description: Hard owned-worker deadline; FFmpeg decode is bounded at 180 s.

limitations: Experimental and analysis only: no audio is written or filtered (32.70 Hz content untouched); no default detector, profile or master is adopted.

The offset correction combines an operator-declared acoustic path (distances, temperature-bounded speed of sound), a declared amp-chain term, per-class detector bias measured on the real click and isolated real attacks against a fine-onset reference whose own bias comes from noise-free synthetic probes, and a +/-1 ms residual floor; GUM root-sum-square, k=2.

Abstains when the expanded uncertainty exceeds the 5 ms decision margin, when segments, click or attack events are insufficient, when the click grid does not fit, when distances are out of bounds, or when the played-on-click consistency check fails. Played-on-click attacks never set the offset; human intent is not ground truth.

Phone input latency is treated as common-mode within one recording (inference); signal-dependent device processing, reflections, legato/tapping/sweep attacks and click identity in the take are uncalibrated or unverified. Placement match is operator-declared.

dependencies.note: Needs an operator calibration clip recorded with the same setup and placement as the take; no real clip exists yet.

agent_workflow.identify: Confirm the clip was recorded with the take's setup and placement and that SEG.json spans were reviewed.
agent_workflow.research: Read docs/research/2026-10-07-capture-latency-calibration.md and the spec; inspect abstain_reasons, components and consistency_check.
agent_workflow.iterate: On abstention, re-record or measure (never loosen thresholds); compare records across sessions.
agent_workflow.acceptance: A calibrated record is an uncertainty-bounded synthetic-validated estimate; real-take validity needs operator spot-checks and listening.

tools.name: timing_calibration_apply
tools.title: Calibrated phrase-timing view (experimental)
tools.description: Apply a calibrated capture-latency record to an existing phrase_timing schema-2 JSON and write a new phrase-timing-calibrated.json: per phrase the verbatim source entry plus a calibrated median, combined uncertainty and a direction emitted only beyond max(U_phrase, 5 ms), else within_uncertainty. The source file is never modified; never a performance grade or missed-note verdict.
tools.intent: Let a musician see which phrases are ahead of or behind the click only where the calibrated evidence exceeds its uncertainty.

phrase_timing.description: phrase_timing schema-2 phrase-timing.json; bounded regular .json, at most 64 MiB; traversal, URL and symlinked-file inputs reject. Read only.

calibration.description: calibration-record.json from timing_calibration_analyze with status calibrated; bounded regular .json, at most 64 MiB; traversal, URL and symlinked-file inputs reject. Read only.

output_root.description: Directory beneath repository artifacts/ (never artifacts/runs); each call writes views/<UTC>-<hex12>/phrase-timing-calibrated.json.

limitations: Writes a new phrase-timing-calibrated.json; the phrase-timing input is never modified and both input hashes are re-read after writing.

Direction (ahead_of_click/behind_click) is emitted only when |calibrated median| exceeds max(sqrt(U_cal^2 + U_median^2), 5 ms); otherwise within_uncertainty. Phrases whose onset median coincides with the click's own broadband self-detection are withheld.
Refuses (typed, nothing written) without a calibrated record, on detector-identity (rhythm_sha256) or setup-id mismatch, on a non-schema-2 phrase timing, or under artifacts/runs.

Directions are review hypotheses for listening about the calibrated source-emission offset; never a performance grade, missed/extra note or note-level verdict. No real-take direction has been validated.

dependencies.note: phrase_timing must come from the same rhythm.py (rhythm_sha256) as the calibration record.

agent_workflow.identify: Confirm setup id, rhythm_sha256 and the take's placement match the record.
agent_workflow.research: Inspect calibration_consumed, per-phrase combined_uncertainty_ms and withheld_basis before reading directions.
agent_workflow.iterate: No knobs; after rhythm, phrase spans or calibration change, write a fresh view and compare.
agent_workflow.acceptance: Directions are listening hypotheses; no performance grade, missed or extra note, or listening acceptance.

recipes_requested.timing-calibration-analyze: INPUT SEGMENTS DISTANCES METHOD AMP_CHAIN SETUP_ID OUTPUT_ROOT -> timeout 600 python3 scripts/timing_calibration.py analyze INPUT --segments SEGMENTS --distances DISTANCES --distance-method METHOD --amp-chain AMP_CHAIN --setup-id SETUP_ID --output-root OUTPUT_ROOT
recipes_requested.timing-calibration-apply: PHRASE_TIMING CALIBRATION SETUP_ID OUTPUT_ROOT -> timeout 600 python3 scripts/timing_calibration.py apply --phrase-timing PHRASE_TIMING --calibration CALIBRATION --setup-id SETUP_ID --output-root OUTPUT_ROOT
